session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trap Bull Reversal then Lower High Major Trend Reversal' (Mon 2026-06-08). Reading: large gap up at the open, brief sell climax, then a bear trap at the EMA and an opening double bottom turned the morning bullish (rally to ~7478); bears had sold limit orders at the 50% pullback of yesterday's bear trend (daily ETH inset 5/15-6/5), so the failed H3 and a bear spike broke the bull trend line and closed below the EMA, starting the MTR down. Two 'Double Top Lower High' retests, a triangle wedge bear flag to the EMA, a breakout test and an MM bear spike drove the day to ~7405, with an EOD tight range into the close. Title includes both a bull reversal and a bear MTR; reversal_day chosen (0.7). Axis: plain-PT style Mon 09:45-16:00 with Tue edge marker.
